title: Certify fast point evaluation and dual maps on the new 96-bit pair
status_note: Prospective experiment only; not runnable or published to cairn. Implementation, independent verification and a frozen protocol must land before ready promotion.
blocked_on: pr:1888 verified conductor-gap baseline and inputs must merge
note:Implement square-root Velu point evaluation and the independent dual-map checker; the current constructor outputs codomains only.
question: Can the certified 96-bit codomain construction be extended to independently verified point transport and dual composition?
decision_value: A verified transport permits comparisons on the same hidden scalar and prices the actual bridge between strata. A codomain without point transport cannot support that end-to-end comparison.

resources.notes: Planning estimate only: the recorded codomain process took 2697.60 wall seconds and 9362772 KiB maximum RSS. Point and dual evaluation have not been measured. Eight core/wall hours is a provisional allowance for small-reference checks and sequential large-map evaluations, not a bound.

env.recipe: Build from the reviewed merged code commit with Rust 1.98 and the declared native dependencies. No environment or task has been published by this card.

cairn.notes: Funding is a priority proposal for review, not a remote funding action. Select the lab, implement resumable execution and independently verify the driver before ready promotion.

funding.rationale: At the lower seed-card funding level: the largest-gap endpoints exist, but point evaluation remains new implementation work.
